_about: Allow-lists of tools/argonia_world/quest_text_check.py. rhetorical: [{key, text, why}] a spoken line allowed a '?' or a Give/Tell/Show-me opening (key = the topic key or row key; text = a phrase of the line). gives_ok: [{key, text, why}] a line allowed to open 'Here is', 'Here are', 'Take this' with no `gives`. retired: {quest id: [nouns the build cut]} searched word-bounded, case-insensitively, in that quest's lines, entries and objectives. roles: {quest id: {role phrase: person name}} a journal entry or objective naming the role must name the person in the same sentence.

rhetorical.why: a refusal of a Speech check that names what would change it; the player answers with the check, not a topic
the speaker echoes the player's own words back; it asks nothing

gives_ok.why: the fragment pays 100 gold and three lockpicks (ARG_QF_TG01 Fragment_40)
